sloka: प्रत्याख्यातो अस्मि भद्रम् वो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना ।यष्टु कामो महायज्ञम् तत् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्थथ ॥१-५७-१८॥
transliteration: pratyākhyāto asmi bhadram vo vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā ।yaṣṭu kāmo mahāyajñam tat anujñātum arthatha ॥1-57-18॥

translations.english: O Gentle sage it is my intention to enter heaven with my physical body. I performed a hundred sacrifices but did not reap its fruit.
